1: Aey logon, maal aur aulad par ek doosre se fakhr karne ne tumhein Allah ki farmanbardari se gaafil kar diya,
2: yahan tak ke tum mar jao aur apni qabron mein daakhil ho jao.
3: Yeh laiq nahin ke us par ek doosre se fakhr karna tumhein Allah ki farmanbardari se gaafil kar de; tum bahut jald is gaflat ka anjaam jaan loge.
4: Tum yaqeenan us ka natija dekh loge.
5: Beshak agar tum yaqeen se jaan lete ke tumhein Allah ki taraf dobara zinda kiya jayega, aur woh tumhein tumhare aamaal ka badla dega, to tum maal aur aulad par ek doosre se fakhr karne mein mashgool na hote.
6: Allah ki qasam! Tum qayamat ke din jahannum ko zaroor dekhoge.
7: Phir tum usey is tarah dekhoge ke tumhein koi shak na rahega.
8: Phir Allah us din tum se us sehat aur maal waghairah ke baare mein zaroor poochega jo us ne tumhein niyamat ke taur par diya.
